info.headline: काभ्रे: रोशी खोला (रोशी पुल) सतर्कता तहभन्दा माथि, बढ्दो
info.description: आधिकारिक (DHM, विपद् पोर्टल अलर्ट ४६४८०, मंसिर २ साँझ ५:२० बजे): कोशी बेसिनको रोशी खोला (काभ्रे, रोशी पुल स्टेशन) सतर्कता तह (३.० मि.) भन्दा माथि छ। जलस्तर ३.२२ मि. (खतरा तह ४.० मि.), बढ्दो।
info.instruction: खोला किनार र पार गर्ने ठाउँबाट टाढा रहनुहोस्; बाढी सूचना: ११५५(२)।

info.senderName: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology (DHM), via BIPAD Portal · relayed by Gati
info.headline: Kavrepalanchok: Roshi Khola (Roshi Bridge) above warning level, rising
info.description: Official (DHM, BIPAD Portal alert 46480, Mangsir 2 / 18 Nov, 5:20 PM): the Roshi Khola at the Roshi Bridge gauge, Kavrepalanchok (Koshi basin), is above its warning level (3.0 m). The water level was 3.22 m against a danger level of 4.0 m, and rising.
info.instruction: Keep away from the stream bank and crossings; flood information: 1155(2).

parameter.value: Kavre: Roshi Khola above warning level, rising; below danger level (3.22/4.0 m)
